notes: two branches written with their own names and no shared tail: the first has four co-transmitters at its head; «قال يحيى أخبرنا وكيع» is Yahya again, written once (rule 7)
«- وهو ابن مرة -» is an editor gloss, left out; the «أبي» of the second branch is Ubayd Allah's father, named only by relation
the Prophet's practice and «أبي أبو أوفى» in the saying are not links
